items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Anthropic财务数据引社区看多浪潮：收入半年暴增15倍，效率与现金流双改善

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，Anthropic 今日正式提交 S-1 招股书后，X 平台上围绕其财务数据的讨论迅速升温。看多派认为，公司展现出「历史级」增长与商业化落地能力，为潜在 2 万亿美元 IPO 估值提供支撑。核心看多论据包括：

2026 年上半年收入达 163 亿美元，较上年同期约 11–12 亿美元增长约 14–15 倍；第三季度单季收入进一步升至 168 亿美元，环比增长约 45%。知名科技投资人 Peter Diamandis 指出，亚马逊、谷歌、苹果分别用了 21 年、10 年、20 年才达到年入 160 亿美元规模，而 Anthropic 仅用半个财年即实现。

同时，单位算力效率显著提升：每投入 1 美元算力现可产生约 2.08 美元收入（较此前大幅改善）。部分分析显示，上半年自由现金流已转正（约 34 亿美元），调整后盈利与高净收入留存率（约 900%）进一步增强信心。企业客户质量也被看好，年付费超 10 万美元客户已超 1.19 万家。

看多派强调，尽管账面出现 807 亿美元净亏损，但其中大部分为非现金会计调整，实际运营表现远好于「烧钱」叙事。随着 Claude 等产品加速企业采用，市场正重新评估 Anthropic 的长期增长潜力。

巴西股票EWZ 24小时跌超27%，当前多空比升至4:1，疑似抄底资金入场

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，据 TradingBeats 监测，Hyperliquid 上 Trade.xyz 部署的巴西股票 ETF 合约 EWZ 暂报 32.72 美元，24 小时下跌约 27.22%，成交额约 1 亿美元，未平仓合约达 3200 万美元。

过去 24 小时，全网爆仓 EWZ 爆仓量达 1491.67 万美元，其中多单爆仓 1472.75 万美元，空单爆仓 18.92 万美元。当前多空比升至 4:1，疑似抄底资金入场，EWZ 过去 5 小时回升 5.3%。

本轮下跌伴随巴西大选结果落定，市场此前的押注方向开始反转。北京时间今日 08:08，巴西最高选举法院确认卢拉胜选连任。此前市场曾押注右翼候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗胜选，期待其推动财政收紧、降低融资成本并支撑雷亚尔走强。

路透社报道，截至上周五，巴西股市较首轮投票前上涨近 7%，雷亚尔兑美元升值近 5%。卢拉连任后，这一交易逻辑面临重新评估。

瑞银全球财富管理新兴市场首席投资官 Alejo Czerwonko 认为，首轮投票后的市场涨势可能大幅回吐，后续仍需看到可信的财政纪律承诺及债务稳定路径。

items.content:
In brief
- Anthropic has filed to list its Class A shares on Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT," with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading the underwriters.
- The company reported first-half 2026 revenue of $16.3 billion, up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, and a net loss of $80.7 billion.
- A trust will elect a majority of Anthropic's board, while an entity owned by its seven co-founders will hold 50.1% of shareholder voting power.
Anthropic, the developer of the Claude family of AI models, has filed for an initial public offering, the company announced on Monday.
The company plans to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "ANT," according to its S-1 registration statement. The number of shares and the price range have not yet been set. Both Anthropic and existing shareholders will sell shares, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley named first among 24 underwriters.
Anthropic has filed an S-1 registration statement with the SEC related to its proposed IPO.
Read more: https://t.co/zuRMrxXzNx
Legal disclaimer: A registration statement relating to these securities has been filed with the SEC but has not yet become effective. These securities…
— Anthropic (@AnthropicAI) October 26, 2026
The public filing follows a confidential draft submitted to the SEC in June. Details of that draft reported by Reuters last month included backers' hopes for a valuation above $2 trillion. In May, Anthropic raised $65 billion at a $965 billion valuation.
Anthropic reported revenue of $16.29 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with $1.16 billion in the same period a year earlier. Full-year revenue was $4.59 billion in 2025, up from $386 million in 2024 and $41 million in 2023.
The company recorded a net loss of $80.7 billion for the first half of 2026. Most of that came from a $72.4 billion charge for changes in the fair value of convertible notes and other instruments, which the filing says was primarily driven by an increase in its valuation. Its operating loss for the period was $693 million.
As of June 30, 2026, Anthropic had raised $141.1 billion in total and held $112.4 billion in cash and cash equivalents, plus $19.3 billion in short-term investments, according to the filing. As of September 30, it had more than 1,900 customers generating at least $1 million in revenue over the previous 12 months, and about 250 generating at least $10 million.
Anthropic's governance structure
Anthropic is incorporated as a public benefit corporation, which requires its directors to balance shareholders' financial interests with those affected by its conduct and its stated purpose: "the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity."
Under the proposed structure, the Long-Term Benefit Trust, a body of five financially disinterested trustees, will elect a majority of the board through a special class of stock. Immediately before the offering, Anthropic will issue a single Class F share to an entity owned by its seven co-founders, carrying 50.1% of the voting power on most shareholder matters. The filing says that makes Anthropic a "controlled company" under Nasdaq rules.
Holders of Class A shares will get one vote per share. The filing warns that the structure "may effectively eliminate the ability of holders of our Class A common stock to influence important decisions, including a change in control."
Anthropic has also contributed about 847 million non-voting shares, representing 5% of its fully diluted shares as of June 30, to a wholly owned subsidiary dedicated to its public benefit purpose. Its co-founders have each pledged to give 80% of their personal equity in the company to philanthropic causes, according to the filing.
The company announced the fund earlier this month, drawing criticism from investor and former White House AI czar David Sacks. "Whether it serves the public good remains to be seen," he tweeted.
Disclosure: This article was drafted with the assistance of Claude, an AI model developed by Anthropic.

Anthropic冲刺11月中旬IPO：代码ANT，募资或超1000亿美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 于 10 月 26 日正式公开提交 S-1 招股书，申请在纳斯达克上市，股票代码确定为 ANT。文件包含 87 份材料，但最关键的发行股数、发行价格和目标估值仍然留空。

《华尔街日报》援引知情人士称，Anthropic 计划在 11 月 16 日当周上市，可能募资 1000 亿美元甚至更多，目标估值约为 1.5 万亿至 2 万亿美元。这些数字尚未写入招股书。公司预计再过两周左右，根据投资者反馈更新发行文件。

正式招股书还有不少此前未被充分报道的细节。

首先是新模型对收入的影响。Anthropic 披露，今年第三季度超过 80% 的营收，来自此前六个月内发布的模型。这意味着即便是几个月前的模型，也可能迅速失去收入贡献。Anthropic 还承认，过去曾出现模型训练失败或效果不及预期的情况，投入的算力没能带来相应收益。一些模型也曾因安全考虑推迟发布或限制开放，但文件没有披露新的、具体的延期型号和时间。

大客户依赖正在减轻。今年第一季度，前五大客户贡献约 36% 的营收，第三季度已降至约 21%。同期五家客户各自贡献的收入却都创下新高。截至 9 月底，Anthropic 已有超过 1.19 万家客户在过去一年贡献至少 10 万美元收入，其中超过 1900 家贡献至少 100 万美元，约 250 家达到千万美元级别。

经营现金流也首次有了完整答案。今年上半年，Anthropic 经营活动现金净流入 39.29 亿美元，去年同期还是净流出 15.13 亿美元。虽然账面仍然巨亏，但实际经营现金流已经转正。公司提醒，供应商付款和客户回款的时间变化也影响了这一结果，不能据此认定已经持续盈利。

算力融资的具体条件更加惊人。Anthropic 与博通相关的融资安排允许其未来发行最高 420 亿美元可转债，年利率为 9%，利息不必立即支付现金，而是计入债务本金。这笔钱只能用于特定算力和基础设施租赁。截至 6 月底，相关额度尚未动用。Google 和亚马逊另外分别提供最高 300 亿和 200 亿美元的后续债务或股权融资安排，但实际提款需要满足特定条件。

招股书还确认，自 2025 年底以来，Anthropic 新签或修改的算力、数据中心租赁及采购合同，涉及约 4170 亿美元的未来最低付款义务。部分长期合同最长达到 20 年。

上市后的卖股规则也很特别。创始人以及部分持股超过 0.5% 的大股东，原则上面临最长 365 天的锁定期，其他多数股东为 180 天。不过，公司设计了分阶段提前解禁机制，部分股份可能在锁定期结束前出售。具体可出售数量仍然留空。

此前，Anthropic 宣称七位创始人承诺捐出个人持股的 80% 用于公益。这次招股书补充说明：这些承诺是自愿的、可以撤销，也不构成具有法律约束力的义务。而且即便创始人捐出个人持股，也不会因此失去通过特殊股权结构掌握的 50.1% 股东投票权。

员工则将获得一类特殊的 Class E 股票。每工作满六个月可获得一股，参与股权捐赠计划还可获得额外股份。这类股票没有经济收益权，只能参与部分董事任免和治理事项的表决。创始人的特殊投票权也有终止条件：当符合资格的创始人成员连续 90 天少于三人时，将启动 450 天过渡期，之后相关特殊股票会被注销。

此外，Anthropic 披露，今年 5 月还签署协议，计划向一家帮助中型企业采用 AI 的新设实体投资 3.25 亿美元。公司也明确表示，自成立以来从未派发现金股息，预计在可预见的未来仍不会分红，未来盈利将优先留在公司继续扩张。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Strategy skips Bitcoin purchases, spends $205M on STRC buybacks
Strategy made no Bitcoin purchases or sales last week, as its STRC preferred stock buybacks reduced its USD Cash balance by 46% to $242.4 million.
Michael Saylor’s Strategy refrained from buying or selling Bitcoin last week, choosing instead to spend $204.9 million on STRC preferred stock buybacks.
Strategy repurchased 2.07 million shares between Monday and Friday, reporting no Bitcoin (BTC) transactions or stock sales through its at-the-market offering program, according to its Monday filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company said its Bitcoin holdings remained at 848,517 BTC, acquired for $64.02 billion at an average price of $75,446 per coin. At Monday’s US equities open, the biggest cryptocurrency was trading hands at roughly $79,992 apiece.
Strategy’s US dollar reserve remained unchanged from the previous week, at $4.83 billion, Its USD Cash balance fell around 46% to $242.4 million from $447.3 million after management used $204.9 million to repurchase STRC shares.
Since October began, Strategy has spent about $664 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, compared with $72.3 million buying 851 BTC.
The pause came as Bitcoin fell toward $80,000 last week after reaching $84,777 on Wednesday, according to CoinGecko.
Strategy’s common stock (MSTR) fell 2.2% to $142.80 in Monday’s premarket activity, while its STRC preferred shares edged down 0.01% to $99.35, according to Yahoo Finance.
Related: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over

items.content:
Here’s what happened in crypto today
Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
Today in crypto, Bernstein analysts said Robinhood’s prediction market earnings could leapfrog crypto, Elon Musk warned that more than 200 AI cloud providers face failure or consolidation as financing tightens and China set a 2030 target for completing its national blockchain network.
HOOD’s prediction markets to exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein
Bernstein analysts expect prediction markets to become one of the incremental earnings drivers for trading platform Robinhood Markets (HOOD), potentially surpassing its crypto-derived revenue.
Prediction markets could drive up to $1.7 billion in business for Robinhood by 2028, surpassing the projected $1.6 billion in crypto-based revenues for that year, according to a Bernstein analysts’ forecast shared with Cointelegraph on Monday.
The analysts expects Robinhood’s prediction market revenue to increase to $1.7 billion in 2028 from about $650 million this year, accounting for roughly 18% of Robinhood’s projected $9.4 billion in total 2028 revenue.
The forecast comes a day ahead of Robinhood’s third-quarter 2026 report and shows that prediction markets are becoming a growing revenue source for the retail-focused trading platform.
Bernstein expects Robinhood’s Q3 revenue to increase 13% quarter-over-quarter to around $1.5 billion, driven by growing equity notional volumes, options volumes, event contract volumes, along with a recovery in crypto trading volume.
Musk warns over 200 AI neoclouds face ‘guppy-level death’
Elon Musk warns that over 200 specialist AI cloud providers could fail or consolidate as lenders tighten up their purse strings.
Musk said Sunday on X that lenders had largely stopped providing financing to companies without substantial revenue streams outside AI data centers. He said SpaceX had secured $40 billion in debt financing for GPUs because of its investment-grade status and revenue from its Starlink satellite internet and rocket businesses.
“That means the 200+ neoclouds are going to see guppy-level death and consolidation. Some will make it through, but not many,” he said.
Musk’s warning follows an October forecast from research firm Gartner that more than 80% of neocloud providers will cease operating independently by 2030, as the industry struggles to generate sufficient returns on massive AI infrastructure investments.
The warnings could also have implications for Bitcoin miners that have pivoted into AI infrastructure. For example, IREN has expanded into AI cloud services, renting computing power to customers, while Core Scientific provides data center hosting for neocloud customers such as CoreWeave.
China targets 2030 for its national blockchain network buildout
China has set a 2030 target for largely completing a national blockchain network under a five-year digital development plan published Friday.
The 15th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization, which sets priorities calls for deeper blockchain use in trade and finance in the Yangtze River Delta, and deployment at scale in manufacturing and agriculture in the Chengdu–Chongqing region in southwestern China.
Friday’s plan was issued by the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission, a senior body within the ruling Communist Party that coordinates digital development policy.
The document makes the completion target explicit for a project already included in China’s national development plan released in March. A joint policy from the Communist Party’s central leadership and State Council published on Oct. 9 called for its construction.

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Strategy bought no Bitcoin last week, its first pause since mid-September, and sold no shares through its at-the-market offering program, according to an SEC filing.
- The company spent $204.9 million of its USD Cash buying back 2,068,459 shares of STRC, its variable-rate preferred stock, up from $193.1 million the week before.
- Strategy still holds 848,517 BTC, while its USD Cash balance fell to $242.4 million from $447.3 million a week earlier.
Strategy did not buy any Bitcoin last week, breaking a run of weekly purchases that began in mid-September, as it spent $204.9 million buying back its STRC preferred stock instead, the company said on Monday.
The Bitcoin treasury firm also sold no shares through its at-the-market offering program between October 19 and 25, according to an SEC filing. It holds 848,517 BTC, acquired for a total of $64.02 billion at an average of $75,446 per coin.
Strategy has repurchased $205M of $STRC. As of 10/25/26, we hold 848,517 $BTC and $5.1B of USD Assets. $MSTRhttps://t.co/VQ9soVDIii
— Strategy (@Strategy) October 26, 2026
The pause follows a string of smaller Bitcoin purchases. Strategy bought 267 BTC for $22.1 million the previous week, after spending $21.5 million on 250 BTC the week before that and $29 million in the week it posted a $21 billion third-quarter gain.
The STRC buyback, covering 2,068,459 shares, was the largest of those weeks, up from $193.1 million the week before and $192.4 million the week prior. Strategy paid for it entirely from USD Cash, the pool of money it keeps for general purposes including buying Bitcoin, which fell to $242.4 million from $447.3 million a week earlier.
Its separate USD Reserve, which is meant to cover preferred dividends and interest on its debt, held steady at $4.83 billion. After the latest buyback, $956.8 million remains available under the company's $3 billion program for repurchasing its preferred stock, which it raised from $2 billion a week ago. A separate program to buy back MSTR common stock has $1 billion left.
Strategy and the MSCI rules
The pause comes as Strategy faces possible removal from MSCI's widely tracked equity indexes. MSCI finalized a rule on October 15 that treats "non-operating companies," those whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset, as ineligible for its Global Investable Market Indexes from the close of November 30. The index provider will publish the list of affected companies on November 11.
Removal would force funds that track the indexes to sell the affected shares. Strategy chairman Michael Saylor had urged MSCI to drop what he called a "discriminatory" rule.

盈科披露币印破产案最新进展：资产出售获批，债权申报截止日临近

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，据盈科律师事务所披露，币印（Poolin）关联债务人的德州矿场资产出售已获美国新泽西州破产法院批准，交易对价最高约 1.8 亿美元，其中 1 亿美元为交割款，另有最高 8000 万美元与后续里程碑挂钩。案件正逐步转向债权确认与分配阶段，债权人的申报窗口正在收窄。

一般债权申报截止日拟定为 2026 年 12 月 31 日美东时间下午 4 时（北京时间 2027 年 1 月 1 日凌晨 5 时），法院拟于 11 月 10 日听证审议。根据美国《破产法》第 11 章及相关规则，依法需提交 Proof of Claim 的债权，未在法院最终确定的 Bar Date 前申报，可能影响债权确认、计划表决及后续分配。

盈科王裕锋律师表示，外国债权人因错过 Bar Date 丧失分配资格的情况并不少见。跨境破产中，「提交过材料」不等于「完成有效申报」。Poolin 案件涉及大量中国用户，债权形态涵盖平台余额、IOU、矿池收益等，债务人主体识别、金额币种对应、债权性质分类和证据格式都可能影响申报效力。

据悉，盈科律师事务所成立于 2010 年，现有执业律师逾 1200 名，是上海规模领先的律所之一。在破产重组领域，盈科入选钱伯斯《大中华区指南 2026》破产重组榜单；在跨境程序上，盈科通过覆盖 104 个国家的全球法律服务网络，具备协调境外当地律师同步作业的体系化能力。（详情可点击下方原文链接查看）

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
HOOD’s prediction markets to add $1.7B to revenue, exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein
Bernstein analysts raised Robinhood’s revenue estimates through 2026 and 2028, while maintaining their HOOD price target unchanged at $160.
Bernstein analysts expect prediction markets to become one of the incremental earnings drivers for trading platform Robinhood Markets (HOOD), potentially surpassing its crypto-derived revenue.
Prediction markets could drive up to $1.7 billion in business for Robinhood by 2028, surpassing the projected $1.6 billion in crypto-based revenues for that year, according to a Bernstein analysts’ forecast shared with Cointelegraph on Monday.
The analysts expects Robinhood’s prediction market revenue to increase to $1.7 billion in 2028 from about $650 million this year, accounting for roughly 18% of Robinhood’s projected $9.4 billion in total 2028 revenue.
The forecast comes a day ahead of Robinhood’s third-quarter 2026 report and shows that prediction markets are becoming a growing revenue source for the retail-focused trading platform.
Bernstein expects Robinhood’s Q3 revenue to increase 13% quarter-over-quarter to around $1.5 billion, driven by growing equity notional volumes, options volumes, event contract volumes, along with a recovery in crypto trading volume.
Bernstein raised Robinhood’s revenue estimates by 3% for 2026, 4% for 2027 and 3% for 2028, while keeping its $160 price target unchanged, citing higher equities and crypto revenue assumptions.
The Nasdaq-traded shares were poised to open down on Monday, with premarket activity paring the stock price down to $93.60, according to Yahoo Finance. HOOD stock is down more than 29% over the past 12 months.
Related: Netflix FTX trailer was ‘enough to upset me’ in first 30 seconds: former FTX COO

But if they don't, it's going to hurt. And that's their only choice, because otherwise, th...

In brief
- Bitcoin briefly fell below $80,000 over the past day, touching about $79,330, before recovering to trade at $80,264, down 2.7% on the week, per CoinGecko.
- U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw more than $773 million in net outflows on Thursday and Friday, leaving October on course for a net loss.
- Analysts warned of further volatility ahead of the Federal Reserve's decision on Wednesday and the U.S. midterm elections on November 3.
Bitcoin slipped below $80,000 over the past 24 hours, as a sell-off in technology stocks and nervousness ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision weighed on risk assets.
The leading cryptocurrency fell as low as $79,332 before recovering to $80,240, down 2.5% over the past week, according to CoinGecko data. It remains about 36% below its all-time high of $126,080.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $635.5 million in net outflows on Thursday, wiping out most of the gains from a three-day run of inflows, followed by a further $137.9 million on Friday, according to SoSoValue. Even so, the funds ended the week up about $301 million, snapping a two-week losing streak, though they remain down about $314 million for October.
Tim Sun, senior researcher at HashKey, said the drop was "primarily driven by a broader correction in global risk assets," with growing skepticism toward AI-related technology stocks a major factor.
"Investors are not necessarily questioning the long-term prospects of artificial intelligence, but rather whether current elevated valuations can be justified by future earnings and cash flows," Sun told Decrypt. Outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs and the unwinding of leveraged positions "further amplified the downward pressure," he said.
Daniela Hathorn, senior market analyst at Capital.com, said Bitcoin had come under pressure alongside tech stocks. "Persistent inflation, elevated Treasury yields and expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening have reduced enthusiasm for speculative assets," she told Decrypt.
Bitcoin's key levels
Stephen Wundke, strategy and revenue director at quantitative investment firm Algoz, said $80,000 was a psychologically important mark for many investors, but warned that a break below it could be misleading, given low trading volumes over weekends.
More worrying, he said, was a broader decline in trading volumes as investors pull out of altcoins and park funds in stablecoins. Bitcoin needed to hold the $82,000 level from which it launched rallies in August and September to support the bull case, and staying below it "could see a broader pullback in the coming weeks while the macro uncertainty remains," he said.
"The bull case for Bitcoin is not dead but it is keeping its head below the parapet whilst so many stray bullets are flying across the globe," Wundke added.
Sun said that if Bitcoin falls further, he sees $75,000 as a key support level to watch, and expects volatility to stay elevated.
Hathorn said the Fed's decision on Wednesday and major technology earnings "could prove just as important for Bitcoin as developments within the cryptocurrency market itself." A more hawkish Fed could strengthen the dollar and weigh on risk assets, she said, while "Bitcoin's recovery may remain fragile unless stronger institutional demand accompanies any improvement in broader market sentiment."

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Galaxy’s Alex Thorn argues Bitcoin bottomed in June and is now in an accumulation phase, calling it “an attractive time to buy and hold bitcoin.”
- Bitcoin has closed five straight weeks above its 50-week average, and its market value never fell below its realized value, a first for any bear market.
- Thorn cites $40 trillion in federal debt and 5% Treasury yields as fuel for Bitcoin. Galaxy and Thorn disclose holding Bitcoin.
Galaxy Digital’s head of research thinks the worst is over for Bitcoin.
In a report published Monday, Alex Thorn, Galaxy’s head of firmwide research, argued that Bitcoin’s bear market ended in June and that the asset is now in an accumulation phase. “Our conclusion is simple: we believe now is an attractive time to buy and hold bitcoin,” he wrote.
The call comes as Bitcoin struggles for direction. It traded at around $80,000 on Thursday, 36% below its October 2025 high but 39% above its June 30 low. On Sunday, Bitcoin briefly slipped below $80,000 to about $79,700, according to CoinGecko.
Thorn’s case starts with the charts. Bitcoin spent 44 weeks below its 50-week moving average before reclaiming it in September, and the week ended Oct. 18 marked its fifth straight weekly close above that line. Since 2011, Bitcoin has reclaimed the average after a stretch of 20 weeks or more four times. In each case, the price never closed more than 8.4% below the reclaim level over the following year and eventually regained its prior all-time high.
The halving cycle, the roughly four-year event when rewards for Bitcoin miners are cut in half thereby reducing new supply, points the same way. The three previous cycles bottomed between 777 and 912 days after a halving, and Thursday was day 916. The latest downturn was also the shallowest on record: a 53% drop, compared with declines of 77% to 93% in past cycles.
Onchain data appears to back that up. For the first time in any bear market, Bitcoin’s market value never fell below its realized value, the average price at which every coin last moved. The ratio between the two bottomed at 1.10, compared with lows of 0.56, 0.69 and 0.75 in prior cycles.
Short-term holders, whose coins carried the recovery from $58,525, have an average cost of $74,811 and sit about 9% in profit. Yet the spent-output profit ratio, which tracks whether coins are being sold at a gain, sits at 1.009, suggesting few are cashing out.
Selling pressure is fading, too. Long-dormant coins, unmoved for five years or more, have been sold at about 34,000 BTC a month this year, half the 2024 pace. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have added 87,000 BTC since the June low after holdings fell just 11% from peak to trough while the price dropped 53%, the report found.
Thorn also argued that the macro case has strengthened. Federal debt has reached $40.44 trillion, fiscal 2026 ended with a $1.99 trillion deficit, and the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.31% this month, its highest since 2007. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 sits less than 1% below a record, while Bitcoin would need to rise 53% to reclaim its high.
“A bet against stocks and hard assets is a bet on fiat, the one position that makes no sense today,” Thorn wrote.
The bullish call lands in a choppy market. Spot Bitcoin ETFs swung from a $1 billion three-day inflow streak to two days of heavy outflows this week, leaving October flows in the red.
Last week’s hotter-than-expected inflation data revived bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike, and Bitcoin briefly dipped below $80,000. Higher interest rates lift Treasury yields, the return investors earn for lending to the U.S. government. A bond paying around 5% with almost no risk makes Bitcoin a harder sell, while higher rates make borrowing pricier and strengthen the dollar.
Thorn’s tripwire is a weekly close below the 50-week average, currently $76,540, that isn’t regained within a month. He also noted that Bitcoin “has proven its ability to run to at least $125k, and we see no reason why it can’t retake that level.”
Galaxy and Thorn both disclose that they hold Bitcoin.

items.content:
标普全球完成收购链上安全公司OpenZeppelin，强化链上金融安全评估能力

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，标普全球（S&P Global）宣布，已完成对链上安全公司 OpenZeppelin 的收购，交易于 2026 年 9 月 17 日首次公布，具体财务条款未披露。标普全球表示，此次收购将补充其数字资产风险评估业务，帮助传统金融机构及链上金融企业评估智能合约和底层技术风险。

OpenZeppelin 成立于 2015 年，提供智能合约安全审计、安全开发服务及开源合约库。公司安全团队已完成超过 900 项审计项目，在产品上线前发现超过 1 万个漏洞；其开源智能合约库 OpenZeppelin Contracts 所支撑的累计价值转移规模超过 38 万亿美元，涵盖多种大型稳定币及代币化基金。

收购完成后，OpenZeppelin 将以独立业务部门形式继续运营，创始人 Demian Brener 留任并向标普全球评级总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报。公司表示，OpenZeppelin Contracts 将继续保持开源、免费及公开维护。

标普全球认为，随着更多金融资产和资本市场业务转向链上，智能合约及底层技术风险评估将变得更加重要。此次收购旨在将 OpenZeppelin 的链上安全技术与标普全球的机构客户网络及全球分销能力结合，拓展其数字资产风险评估服务。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
IOSG Ventures宣布投资Fun，后者为Polymarket等平台提供全球资金通道

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，IOSG Ventures 宣布投资 Fun，押注面向互联网市场的全球资金基础设施。Fun 为预测市场、链上永续合约平台及 DeFi 应用提供法币交易，支付路由和跨链资金结算服务，帮助用户在不同法币、数字资产及区块链网络之间转移资金。

据 IOSG 介绍，Polymarket 的法币交易均通过 Fun 处理，Lighter、Aave 等平台也在使用其服务。Fun 目前处理的资金量按年化计算已达 1000 亿美元，业务覆盖 150 多个国家和地区、50 多种支付方式。

IOSG 认为，随着预测市场、链上交易平台及代币化资产应用扩张，资金能否顺畅进出将直接影响用户转化率和平台增长。Fun 试图通过统一的资金接入层，降低平台自行整合法币通道、钱包、稳定币及多条区块链的复杂度。公司由 Alex Fine 于 2022 年创立。

items.content:
比特币财库公司Empery投资6500万美元布局AI数据中心，瞄准15年长期现金流

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，比特币财库公司 Empery Digital（NASDAQ：EMPD）计划投资 6500 万美元，获得收购美国中西部一处 AI 数据中心物业的私人实体 25% 股权。该设施目前拥有约 150 MW 电力容量及自有变电站，未来有望扩容至约 300 MW。

根据公司此前披露的信息，该项目拟采用为期 15 年的三净租赁（NNN）模式，潜在租赁付款总额约为 10 亿美元。按此前规划，Empery 持有的 25% 股权对应的租赁收入预计在租期内超过 4.4 亿美元，款项有望于 2027 年初开始支付。不过，相关租赁安排仍需以最终签署的正式协议为准。

此次投资反映出 Empery 正将业务布局从比特币财库拓展至 AI 基础设施领域。公司此前表示，其对该项目的资金投入义务限于 6500 万美元，潜在租户将承担数据中心改造、用电及运营成本。

items.author: Tyler Warner
items.content:
Morning Minute is a daily newsletter written by Tyler Warner. The analysis and opinions expressed are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of Decrypt. And check out our daily news show 'FOMO HOUR' covering all of the top stories and market action.
GM!
Today’s top news:
- Crypto majors cool over the weekend; BTC at $80.2k
- BTC ETFs close week with $300M net inflows despite outflows Thurs+Fri
- Solana trading bot Bloom was exploited for $947k; team promising reimbursement
- Big week ahead with RH earnings Tues, FOMC Weds and Q3 GDP + PCE data
- Pump announced a $2.5M Squads competition kicking off today and running 2 weeks
Bitcoin Breaks Below $80,000 as Iran Fears Hit the Weekend
Bitcoin slid below $80,000 this weekend after the Wall Street Journal reported Saturday that the U.S. is rapidly evacuating personnel from embassies and military bases across the Middle East. In a Friday memo to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton wrote that “Iran has substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel.” The evacuations go well beyond earlier reports of diplomatic staff being pulled from Saudi Arabia.
BTC currently sits at $80,160, down 2.4% on the week. Ethereum fell 3.8% to $2,322, Solana 3.2% to $101 and the broader CMC20 index is off 2.3%.
Over 30 days, Bitcoin is down 4.8%. The majors around it average down 16.5%, more than three times as much. Ethereum off 13.6%, Solana 17.1%, XRP 17.4%, Hyperliquid 17.4%, Dogecoin 22.3%.
There is some positive. Zcash is up 8% on the week while everything else bled, and sits up 135% on the year. Monero is up 37%. Privacy is still catching a bid, in a week when the lead story is governments evacuating people ahead of attacks.
And we have a big week ahead. The Fed decides its next move with interest rates Wednesday at FOMC with Kevin Warsh’s press conference after, the ECB follows Thursday and the Bank of Japan Friday. Q3 GDP and September PCE data land on Thursday, the same day Coinbase and Strategy report after the bell.
Arguably more important than those above, at least for onchain, is the Robinhood earnings call on Tuesday the 27th. Will Vlad and crew address the tokenized stock pushback? Will they mention Robinhood Chain and its memestonk ecosystem? Will they launch a builders grant program? Big questions to answer, and ones that will likely decide the near-term future of that ecosystem.
And of course, U.S. midterms are eight days away. Expect another volatile week…
🌎 Macro Crypto and Markets
- Crypto majors are slightly red; BTC +0.2% at $80.2k; ETH +0.4% at $2,330; SOL +1% at $101.5; HYPE +2% at $77; ZEC +4% at $1,230
- Top alt movers include QNT (+17%), ENA (+5%) and PYTH (+6%)
- Oil -2% at $101; Gold +0.4% at $4,025
- Stock futures are slightly green as oil falls; DOW +0.35%, Nasdaq even
- Crypto faces its heaviest macro week of the quarter with Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan decisions Wednesday through Friday alongside Q3 GDP and PCE, plus earnings from Robinhood and SoFi on Tuesday and Coinbase and Strategy on Thursday
- Goldman Sachs expects global growth to hold broadly stable through 2027 but sees downside risks building from higher energy prices, rising bond yields and slowing AI investment, while arguing that cooling inflation and AI’s growing visibility in employment data mean central banks hike less than expected
- Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna and Intuit joined the companies objecting to tokenized versions of their shares on the OKX-ICE venue, taking the count to 22 in eight days
- Electrum patched a flaw that let malicious servers steal funds from users bumping a transaction fee, after the wallet trusted servers to report pending transactions without verifying signatures
Corporate Treasuries & ETFs
- The Bitcoin ETFs saw $138M in net outflows on Friday; the ETH ETFs saw $4M in net inflows in a welcome reversal
Meme Coin Tracker
- Meme leaders were mixed; DOGE +1%, SHIB even, PEPE -1%, PENGU +3%, TRUMP +2%, SPX +3%, BONK even
- Robinhood chain leaders were mostly green after a bad Saturday selloff; Pons +6% to $160M; AI +8% at $59M; Cashcat even at $90M; GF +85%, Bow +20% and Gage +33% led top movers
- Solana top movers included Launch +50x, Kimchi +70%, Dood +60% and Claudia +50%; Stonk +13% to $133M
💰 Token, Airdrop & Protocol Tracker
- Hyperliquid led onchain protocols in revenue on the week with $14.74M, followed by Pump with $13.76M, Papertrade with $6.67M, and Collector Crypt with $5.31M
- Solana trading bot Bloom said attackers drained about 9,408 SOL worth $947,000 from 49 wallets belonging to nine users by exploiting a third-party module to gain remote code execution, insisting no private keys were compromised and pledging to reimburse 100% of stolen funds
- Pump.fun announced a $2.5M squads competition that will start today and run for 2 weeks, with the top 3 squads earning prizes based on PNL + uPNL
🚚 What is happening in NFTs?
- NFT leaders were mostly green; Punks even at 30.7 ETH, BAYC +5% at 6 ETH, Pudgy +3% at 2.56 ETH
- Identity MD (+13%) and Argonauts (+7%) led top movers

万亿AI投资撑起美国经济，但生产率奇迹仍未出现

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，AI 基础设施投资正成为美国经济增长的重要支撑，但尚未带来明显的长期生产率跃升。经济学家预计，美国第三季度实际 GDP 折年率增速约为 3%，主要受消费者支出和 AI 相关商业投资推动，企业围绕数据中心建设、计算设备采购的资本支出持续扩张。

不过，投资增长并不意味着 AI 已显著提升整体经济效率。目前，美国潜在经济增速仍徘徊在 2% 左右，美国国会预算办公室（CBO）预计，长期潜在增速约为 1.8%。经济学家指出，近期劳动生产率改善尚难确认是否由 AI 驱动，相关收益仍需更多数据验证。

与此同时，美国经济仍面临通胀压力。标普全球数据显示，美国 10 月综合 PMI 初值从 9 月的 58.4 降至 57.6，但产出价格指数升至 59.8，创 2022 年 8 月以来最高水平，显示企业成本压力仍在加剧。

AI 投资能否最终转化为持续的生产率提升，仍是美国经济能否突破长期增长瓶颈的关键。现阶段，数万亿美元级别的投资规划尚不足以证明美国已进入经济增速持续抬升的新阶段。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Aviva Investors launches tokenized share class of $29B Sterling fund on XRP Ledger
The move marks Aviva’s second fund to list tokenized shares, part of a broader collaboration to bring more tokenized funds to the XRP Ledger.
Aviva Investors, the asset management arm of UK-based insurer Aviva, launched a tokenized share class of its Sterling (GBP) Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger (XRPL).
The development adds a tokenized share class of the company’s largest fund of approximately 22 billion British pounds ($29.4 billion) in assets under management on XRPL and allows investment in the fund in tokenized format, Ripple and Aviva revealed in a joint announcement on Monday.
It is the asset manager’s second tokenized fund, after Aviva expanded its USD Liquidity Fund to the XRPL network earlier in July.
Aviva said this makes it one of Europe’s largest asset management providers of tokenized money market funds, with about 86 million pounds invested across its two tokenized share class offerings.
Aviva made an 50-million-pound investment in the Sterling Liquidity Fund’s new tokenized share class, according to the announcement. The expansion is part of a broader collaboration between Aviva and Ripple, seeking to bring more tokenized funds to the XRP Ledger.
The XRP Ledger ranks as the ninth-largest blockchain network for tokenized assets, with $642 million in total distributed real-world asset value and about 2,900 unique holders, according to RWA.xyz data.
Related: Public companies object to OKX-ICE’s tokenized stock plan

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
台积电A14工艺将SRAM单元面积缩至0.017平方微米以下，时隔8年重启微缩

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，台积电计划在目标于 2028 年量产的 A14 工艺中，将高密度 6T SRAM（静态随机存取存储器）位单元面积缩小至 0.017 平方微米以下，打破自 2020 年 N5 工艺以来长期停滞在约 0.021 平方微米的局面。

报道称，台积电预计将在年末公布相关研究成果。按目前已披露的数据，A14 工艺的 SRAM 单元面积有望领先英特尔 18A 工艺；后者此前公布的高密度 SRAM 单元面积为 0.021 平方微米。由于三星尚未公开最新工艺的具体 SRAM 单元尺寸，暂时难以进行直接比较。

SRAM 是 CPU、GPU 及 AI 加速芯片内部用于高速缓存的关键存储组件。单元面积缩小后，同等芯片面积可容纳更多缓存，有助于缓解 AI 芯片的数据访问瓶颈，并改善性能与能效。

台积电表示，A14 工艺相较 N2 工艺的目标是性能提升 10% 至 15%、功耗降低 25% 至 30%、芯片密度提高约 20%。该工艺目前正朝 2028 年量产目标推进，但最终良率、成本及客户采用情况仍有待确认。

items.content:
苹果盘前跌1.44%，iPhone Duo屏幕接连出现破损，铰链设计或面临重新调整

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，据 BIT（Bit.com）行情数据，苹果美股盘前跌 1.44%。消息面上，苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 自 10 月 23 日在主要市场上市后，陆续出现铰链附近屏幕破损问题。用户上传的照片显示，部分设备的屏幕从铰链中央出现白色射线状裂痕，并延伸至屏幕右下方。

业内人士认为，缺陷集中出现在铰链同一位置，可能与铰链设计有关，苹果或不得不重新设计相关结构。报道称，苹果在研发阶段就面临铰链供应问题，原定第一供应商美国安费诺因生产良率不及预期，供应地位被台湾新日兴取代，但后者同样面临生产困难，曾通过筛选符合标准的「黄金样品」供货。

苹果此前表示，iPhone Duo 的铰链包含 100 多个零部件，并采用 3D 打印铰链模组。由于产品已进入量产阶段，苹果可能需要通过减少铰链组件等方式，在尽量缩小设计改动的同时解决缺陷。

报道指出，铰链问题可能影响产品交付及销售表现。苹果据称向供应商提供的预期显示，截至今年年底，iPhone Duo 完整机产能对应的零部件供应量约为 600 万台。另据报道，零部件供应商 Fine M-Tec 已声明，近期相关产品质量问题与其供应的零部件组装无关。

items.ai_reason: The central bank rebuke occurred on Saturday, before the news window, and the article recaps that statement plus political reactions without a concrete in-window development.
items.ai_summary: The Bank of Israel rejected Prime Minister Netanyahu's suggestion that cryptocurrency could help Israel evade sanctions, warning the plan would harm the economy amid election criticism.
items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- The Bank of Israel said crypto cannot be used to get around sanctions, after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he was working on a blockchain-based plan.
- More than 100 economists, including former central bank governor Jacob Frenkel and several Nobel laureates, warned the plan would damage Israel's economy.
- Netanyahu's rivals seized on the comments ahead of Tuesday's election, with challenger Gadi Eisenkot dismissing it as a "BibiCoin policy."
Israel's central bank has rejected Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's suggestion that cryptocurrency could help the country get around potential international sanctions, in a rare public rebuke days before Tuesday's national election.
Cryptocurrencies "cannot serve as a means to circumvent sanctions imposed on Israel," the Bank of Israel said in a statement on Saturday, according to the Financial Times. "The right course of action for the Israeli economy is to preserve economic relations with our primary trading partners and to focus on preventing sanctions and their negative impact on the economy," it added.
Netanyahu said in a Channel 10 interview on Friday that Israel needed to prepare for possible banking sanctions, and that he had asked for a plan to use crypto and blockchain networks to get around them. "Blockchain is one of the alternatives, certainly," he said. He did not say who was drafting the plan or which currency or network it would use.
Netanyahu later said he was taking the central bank's position into account but would do what he believed was best, The Times of Israel reported.
Countries including the UK, France and Canada have announced or pledged restrictions on trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank, amid criticism of settlement expansion and rising settler violence.
On Sunday, more than 100 economists, including former Bank of Israel governor Jacob Frenkel and several Nobel laureates, signed a letter warning that the plan would bring higher unemployment and a collapse in foreign investment, Reuters reported. They called it "a puzzling solution, one accepted in criminal organizations, that will not help in the slightest."
Gadi Eisenkot, Netanyahu's main challenger in Tuesday's election, called the idea "madness" and said the "BibiCoin policy" would drive companies abroad, while opposition leader Yair Lapid compared what Netanyahu called a "bypass economy" to those of Iran, Russia and Venezuela.
Crypto and sanctions
Economists also questioned whether the plan would work at all. "It's not possible to circumvent sanctions with digital currencies as the blockchain system is publicly open and transparent, which means that every transfer is registered and can be traced to its origin," Gali Ingber, head of finance studies at the College of Management Academic Studies, told The Times of Israel.
Israel has itself used blockchain tracing to target sanctioned groups. In July, Defense Minister Israel Katz signed sanctions orders on 37 crypto wallets holding more than 24 million shekels that Israel said belonged to Iran's Revolutionary Guards.
Opinion polls point to a possible stalemate in Tuesday's election, with neither Netanyahu's coalition nor the opposition alliance on course for a governing majority.

items.ai_summary: Bitcoin is testing $80,000 support ahead of a week dominated by the Federal Reserve rate decision, US tech earnings, and inflation data, with markets expecting the Fed to hold rates at 3.75%-4%.
items.author: Cointelegraph by William Suberg
items.content:
BTC price risks $80K loss into FOMC, earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
Bitcoin bulls fought for $80,000 support over the weekend ahead of a heavy week of US tech earnings and inflation data.
Bitcoin (BTC) begins the last week of October fighting to hold $80,000 support ahead of a busy week of US macro data and earnings reports.
Key points:
- Markets see the Fed holding interest rates in their current 3.75-4% range at its meeting on Wednesday as Brent crude cools to $110 per barrel.
- South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index resumes downside ahead of a major round of US corporate earnings results.
- Bitcoin is on track to end October down 4%, copying 2025 performance, as $80,000 support appears weak.
Markets see Fed rate-hike pause with oil still above $100
The US Federal Reserve is in focus for macro analysts this week as it will decide the next move on the federal funds rate on Wednesday. Markets will be watching the rate decision by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), as well as language used by Fed chair Kevin Warsh at the accompanying press conference.
Markets have little doubt over what officials will decide, seeing over 90% odds that rates will stay in their current 3.75-4% range. FedWatch data shows consensus favoring a 0.25% hike at the December FOMC meeting.
Fed target-rate probabilities (screenshot). Source: CME Group
Commenting, economist Robin Brooks argued that such expectations were a gift to Warsh, who would not need to fight external demands to change course.
“After very contentious Fed meetings earlier in 2026, this week’s meeting gets zero interest in markets, which price only 12% odds of a hike. That’s nothing versus how markets tried to push Warsh into hiking back in July. A temporary reprieve for Warsh,” he summarized.
In separate analysis last week, Brooks saw a rate pause as all but inevitable, even amid rising oil prices and growing concerns over military escalation in the Middle East. Brent crude reached $117 per barrel on Friday, its highest level since March 19, before dropping to around $110 on Monday. Even a rise to $125, however, would not force the Fed to change course, he continued.
“The debt crisis in France would escalate sharply, anxiety around all the AI and data center debt would increase and the S&P 500 would tumble. That just isn’t a setting where the Fed is itching to hike,” Brooks wrote.
“If anything, financial conditions would be tightening sharply, so the last thing you’d want to do is hike.”
CFDs on Brent crude oil one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
On Thursday, new US macro data will be released in the form of the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) index, known as the Fed’s “preferred” inflation gauge. Last month, PCE came in lower than expected at 3.4% year-on-year, but analysts explained that the drop was a result of changes to the way certain index elements are calculated.
KOSPI struggles as markets prepare for US tech earnings
Nerves about prospects for the AI sector continued to pressure equities on Monday ahead of the week’s first Wall Street open.
After attempting to recoup some of its losses late last week, South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index closed down 1.5% on Monday at 5,469 points. On Friday, the tech-heavy index fell as low as 5,308 points — a level not seen since late July.
KOSPI Composite Index one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
The low came as a result of significant tech-stock selling as foreign capital sought safety. Last week, stronger-than-expected US earnings reports ultimately failed to lift the mood, with attention instead drawn to Tesla’s reduced Q3 capital expenditure. The Nasdaq Composite Index closed at 25,955 points on Friday, its lowest daily close since Aug. 3.
Nasdaq Composite Index one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Speaking to CNBC on Monday, JPMorgan Asset Management’s Raisah Rasid was unfazed by the state of the AI trade.
“It’s really about investors thinking, ‘Look, we’re not rewarding capex anymore; what we are rewarding is return on capital. I think that’s what’s happening with AI,’” she said.
Further Q3 earnings are due out this week, with Microsoft and Alphabet both reporting after the market close on Wednesday, while Amazon and Intel follow on Thursday. In total, around 20% of S&P 500 companies will report during the week, while Thursday also sees the release of US Q3 GDP numbers.
Bitcoin “Uptober” sentiment meets 4% month-to-date losses
Bitcoin is on track to end October down 4% if the monthly candle closes near current levels around $80,000.
Related: Bitcoin ETFs break 2-week outflow streak with $301M comeback
BTC/USD one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Data from CoinGlass shows that despite average October upside for BTC/USD totaling 26.1% since 2010, earning the nickname ‘Uptober’, both this year and last have bucked the trend. After falling 3.9% in October 2025, Bitcoin went on to lose another 17.5% in November, once more going against historical patterns that have seen average November returns of 35%.
BTC/USD monthly returns. Source: CoinGlass
Almost $150 million of long positions were liquidated over two hours on Saturday as Bitcoin fell to $79,145. The $80,000 level failed to offer support on lower time frames despite its status as a psychological boundary. CoinGlass shows a $73 million wall of bids keeping price above $79,300, with asks centered around $81,000.
BTC liquidation heatmap. Source: CoinGlass
Market participants are increasingly cautious about a rebound under current macro conditions. Benjamin Cowen, founder of crypto analytics platform Into the Cryptoverse, described Bitcoin’s trips to $87,000 in late September and early October as a “fakeout.”
BTC/USD should continue to see weakness through the end of the year, he told X followers on Monday, citing historical precedent and calling for downside pressure around US midterm election years.
As Cointelegraph reported, the resistance zone around $87,000 contains important price points: the 2026 yearly open at $87,490 and 20-month moving average at $87,165.
items.title: BTC price risks $80K loss into FOMC, earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week

items.author: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun
items.content:
Securitize’s tokenized stock value halves as Circle widens lead
SECZ’s onchain market cap fell to $208.6 million as Circle-linked tokens reached a combined $383.6 million across several issuers in the $3.3 billion tokenized equities market.
The value of tokenized shares of Securitize (SECZ) have lost more than half their value in less than a month as the gap with market leader Circle (CRCL) widens.
The market capitalization of SECZ tokens fell from a high of $430.4 million on Sept. 28 to $208.6 million by Sunday, according to Token Terminal. The NYSE-traded shares closed Friday down 2.1% at $7.80 apiece, with a market cap of $1.27 billion.
Tokens tracking Circle’s shares have gained about 20% in market value since Sept. 28 to reach $383.6 million, reclaiming the top spot in the $3.3 billion tokenized stock market.
Tokenized stock market capitalization by underlying stock, excluding ETFs. Source: Token Terminal
The decline in tokenized SECZ coincided with a sell-off in Securitize’s underlying shares on the NYSE, which erased gains that followed the Oct. 8 launch of its stock trading platform on Solana. Citi downgraded SECZ from Buy to Neutral on Oct. 13 amid concerns about tokenization revenue.
Securitize helps asset managers including BlackRock issue securities on blockchains. The company brought its own common shares onchain alongside its July 2 NYSE listing, becoming the largest tokenized equity at the time.
SECZ remains the largest individual tokenized stock as Circle’s total is spread across products from several issuers. Binance’s CRCLb on BNB Chain leads those offerings at $154.1 million.

Blast常规提现界面截止日期已至，桥上仍有4041万美元资产待提取

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，Blast 于今日达到常规提现界面的截止日期，但其以太坊主网官方跨链桥中仍有约 4041 万美元资产。金额较 10 月 2 日约 6350 万美元下降约 36%。Blast 于 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关闭该 Layer 2 网络，理由是运营成本超过收入，且缺乏实现经济可持续发展的可信路径。

Blast 此前表示，10 月 26 日之后，用户仍可提取资产，但需要直接与以太坊上的桥接合约交互，而不能再依赖常规网站界面。报道发布时，Blast 官网仍显示提现入口及网络逐步关闭的提示。Blast 已发布 ETH、USDB 和 BLAST 的合约级提现指南。相关操作涉及在 Blast 网络发起提现、等待交易对应的状态记录提交至以太坊、通过 OptimismPortal 合约提交提现证明，再经过一天的挑战期并执行最终确认交易。

分析：BTC交易者已实现价格再度上升，短中期成本结构仍偏积极

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，CryptoQuant 认证分析师 Trader_Gemini 发文表示，交易者链上已实现价格（Trader On-chain Realized Price）再次上升，当前正成为观察 BTC 后续走势的重要参考指标。该指标反映过去 1 至 3 个月内最后一次发生转移的 BTC 的平均获取价格，可用于衡量近期市场参与者的平均持仓成本。

目前，BTC 交易价格处于 8 万美元低位区间，而交易者已实现价格已升至 7 万美元中段，意味着 BTC 现价仍高于近期交易者的平均成本。从当前结构来看，近期市场参与者整体仍处于浮盈状态，短中期成本结构依然偏积极。从历史表现来看，在市场处于上涨阶段时，交易者已实现价格往往会在 BTC 回调接近该水平时发挥支撑作用。

如果价格能够守住这一成本线，说明近期参与者的持仓成本仍可能为市场提供支撑；反之，若 BTC 跌破该水平，部分处于浮亏状态的交易者可能在价格反弹至接近成本时卖出，从而使该位置由支撑转为阻力。

此外，Trader_Gemini 还提醒关注指标的上轨（Upper Band）。历史上，当 BTC 价格接近上轨时，往往伴随着获利了结压力上升，并可能出现短期回调。因此，若 BTC 继续上涨，上轨附近的市场反应值得重点观察；若 BTC 出现回调，则应关注交易者已实现价格能否提供有效支撑。

Trader_Gemini 强调，上轨并不意味着市场必然见顶，交易者已实现价格也不保证 BTC 一定会反弹，两者都不应被视为自动触发交易的信号，而是用于判断近期市场参与者可能在何种价位改变行为的参考指标。目前 BTC 仍运行在交易者已实现价格上方，整体成本结构尚属积极；若后续出现更深幅度的调整，该指标能否继续发挥支撑作用将成为重要观察点。

以太坊基金会研究员：Glamsterdam测试网升级推迟，EIP-8037引发合约兼容性问题

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，以太坊基金会研究员 Toni Wahrstätter 表示，由于 ChainSecurity 报告揭示 EIP-8037 与部分智能合约存在兼容性及安全问题，核心开发者上周决定推迟 Hoodi 测试网升级至 Glamsterdam。目前已发现的问题包括：交易执行过程中剩余 Gas 可能增加，导致部分 Gas 计数逻辑发生下溢并触发回滚，或使原本不应执行的代码路径被触发，导致交易看似成功。

此外，部分合约可能因无法正确计算调用期间的 Gas 消耗而低估用量。ChainSecurity 此前表示，已发现 13 个真实案例，并正与受影响项目进行负责任披露。Toni Wahrstätter 称，本周将进一步排查相关合约，评估后续解决方案，可能需要应用开发者、核心开发者、审计人员及节点运营方协同处理，最坏情况下或需调整协议规范。他提醒应用开发者和审计人员检查合约对 EIP-8037、EIP-8038 的兼容性，并及时报告问题。

【以太坊基金会研究员：Glamsterdam 中 EIP-8037 对合约的影响已基本明确】

Foresight News 消息，以太坊基金会研究员 Toni Wahrstätter 发推表示，此前以太坊核心开发者之所以推迟了 Hoodi 测试网的 Glamsterdam 升级，是因为研究安全审计机构 ChainSecurity 的一份报告。该报告揭示了 EIP-8037 与部分合约交互时存在的问题，目前其影响已基本明确。已知的是，硬编码转发 Gas 的合约会受到 Gas 重新定价的影响，例如状态写入（SSTORE）成本上升；新发现的是，部分编码模式所依赖的特定不变量被 EIP-8037 打破，已消耗的 Gas 可能在交易中途返还，导致 gasleft（）数值上升，进而引发两个问题，一是调用前后的 Gas 计数器下溢并回滚，二是失败的子调用返还 Gas，使本不应执行的路径被执行，交易看似成功；此外，在调用前后用 GAS 操作码测量 Gas 用量可能出现低估，因为执行期间状态 Gas 储备（state gas reservoir）不可见。Toni Wahrstätter 表示，推迟 Hoodi 升级争取了时间，但无法解决问题，接下来需深入排查合约，最终可能需要应用开发者、核心开发者、审计方、节点运营者等相关方协调，最坏情况下需修改规范。他呼吁应用开发者和审计方检查合约是否存在与 EIP-8037/EIP-8038 相关的问题并进行报告。
https://foresightnews.pro/news/h5Detail/115989

--- Top Comments ---

[amiga386]: Denmark did this in 2014 and didn't need a pile of LLM puffery to do it:  https://minecraftdanmark.dk/   https://geoboxers.com/denmark-in-minecraft/  > ‘Denmark in Minecraft’ was released in April 2014 by the Danish Geodata Agency. The project was conceived, developed and operated by Simon Lyngby Kokkendorff, Thorbjørn Kjærshøj Nielsen and Nynne Sole Dalå, the founders of GeoBoxers. > The work was funded and carried out by the Danish Geodata Agenc...

[petterroea]: Recently I've gotten to a point where I am put off when a clearly vibe coded website asks for money. I have seen too many examples of people trying to earn money on apps they clearly vibe coded in an hour. Why would I pay for that - might as well make it and sideload it myself. I might even publish it for free to the app store to spite them. I really don't think you are in a position to be asking for money if you just made something using an LLM. You didn't put in much work you...

[netsharc]: This AI-written page seems to be typical of LLM: Sentences are 4 to 5 words long, and the reader have to fill in the details. Did someone make 1x1x1 wooden cubes and remade Switzerland? Oh no, the tiny tiny text above the gigantic title says "Minecraft". "Exactly as tall and as steep". How is a mountain that exists in a video game exactly as tall and steep as the real one? Then there's an embedded map that is an attempt to convey information that I still can't fi...

[abricq]: Nice ! I have a fun survival challenge: the swiss Via Alpina hike in Minecraft ! Quickly did the math. The real trail is ~390 km long, with 23,500 m of elevation gain and 14 Alpine passes. I found that Minecraft walking speed is 4.317 m/s (1 block = 1 m), so that's ~25 hours of continuous walking, or ~33 hours assuming 75% movement efficiency for terrain. That's one Alpine pass every ~2.4 hours, and a new hiking-stage destination every ~1h40!

[evrimoztamur]: It's not the most pleasant that you get the constructed buildings embedded into the map as crappy voxel approximations. Would be sweeter to have the terrain only. Also, total LLM goop.

安全研究员利用PHP2Shell漏洞攻破悬赏网站，领走约2000美元比特币奖金

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，安全研究员 killa（GitHub 用户名 KillaBoi）成功利用近期曝光的 PHP 高危漏洞 PHP2Shell（CVE-2026-109618 与 CVE-2026-109619），攻破公开悬赏网站 stealmybitcoin[.]com，并领取价值约 2021 美元的比特币奖金（0.02511679 BTC）。

据悉，10 月 20 日 PHP 核心远程代码执行漏洞曝光后，因公开可靠攻击代码迟迟未出现，有人于 10 月 24 日搭建该网站，故意使用未打补丁的 PHP 版本，并挂出约 500 美元比特币作为「悬赏奖金」，邀请黑客验证漏洞实际可攻击性。奖金后续因捐赠涨至约 2000 美元。挑战开始约 19.5 小时后，killa 编写出可用攻击代码，成功获取服务器上的私钥。网站创建者事后确认挑战被解决，并指出自身放置密钥存在失误，但承认攻击成功。killa 随后在 GitHub 公开了完整 PoC。

Galaxy：约1110万枚比特币无法关联到已知持有者，占已开采总量55%

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，Galaxy Research 10 月快照显示，在约 2010 万枚已开采比特币中，约 1110 万枚（约 55%）所在地址无法与交易所、基金、政府或其他已知实体关联。Galaxy 研究主管 Alex Thorn 表示，这说明尽管机构化程度不断提高，仍有大量比特币可能由个人自托管。Xapo Bank 则认为，这是散户已入场十余年的体现。

不过，这部分未归属的比特币并不全属于长期自托管的个人，也可能包括因私钥遗失或持有人去世而无法访问的币、Galaxy 尚未识别的机构或场外交易商持仓，以及分散在多个地址的托管资产。其余 45% 已有归属，包括交易所、贝莱德等发行商的 ETF 及美国政府；其中单一最大持有者为"中本聪（Patoshi 模式）"，持有 1,123,658 枚 BTC。

Bitunix分析师：美国住房减负难解高利率，欧洲财政疑虑加深市场分歧

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，市场压力正从利率预期延伸至实体供应链、家庭融资与政府财政。美国能源部将氦列为第 20 种关键材料，凸显 AI 及半导体扩产背后的供应瓶颈：美国约占全球氦产量的 43%，但提取设施接近产能极限，新厂建设需要数年；卡塔尔供应又受到中东冲突干扰，晶圆厂 Polar 的三家供应商已有一家限量供货。当数据中心持续拉动芯片需求，关键材料短缺便可能直接限制产能。

美国住房政策也试图回应生活成本压力。特朗普行政令拟让符合条件的新房贷更容易取消私人房贷保险，并扩大再融资产权保险替代方案；但 30 年期房贷平均利率仍约为 7.32%，费用减免难以从根本上扭转购房负担。生活成本因此持续成为中期选举攻防焦点，奥巴马批评特朗普对伊战争推高油价，白宫则反指民主党应为物价压力负责。

欧洲方面，穆迪维持法国 Aa3 评级，却保留负面展望，未能消除市场对财政整顿与政治僵局的疑虑。法国 10 年期国债收益率曾升至 5.14%，杠杆基金欧元净空头头寸升至 2020 年以来高位，显示市场仍要求风险补偿。另一方面，俄罗斯石油贸易网络的跨境诉讼揭示，在制裁环境下，中间商、交货及付款责任更加复杂，法律与结算风险可能进一步干扰能源流通。

后续焦点不只是政策能否在短期内压低成本，而是氦等关键材料是否持续短缺、法国预算能否落地，以及地缘政治是否会再次扰乱能源物流。当供应限制、财政压力与选举因素交织，市场面临的将是成本与风险的重新分配，而非单一资产的短期波动。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373702

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，CryptoQuant 分析师 Axel Adler Jr 发文表示，当前持有时间不足 6 个月的 BTC 平均成本约为 7.6 万美元，当前价格较该成本高出约 5.9%。

过去一周，这一群体的浮盈空间从 8.7% 收窄至 5.9%，同期 BTC 价格下跌约 1000 美元，而其平均持仓成本上升约 1100 美元。数据显示，持有时间不足 6 个月的 BTC 平均成本约为持有超过 6 个月的 BTC 平均成本的 1.56 倍，分别为 7.6 万美元和 4.86 万美元。该比值从 1.54 升至 1.56，主要受到短期持有者平均成本上升推动，而长期持有者的平均成本基本保持不变。

Axel Adler Jr 指出，若 BTC 跌破 7.6 万美元，过去 6 个月买入的这部分 BTC 整体将转为浮亏。上一次出现这种情况是在今年 8 月中旬。需要注意的是，平均成本并不意味着所有近期买入者都处于盈利状态，部分在更高价位买入的投资者仍可能面临亏损。

items.content:
Bitcoin ETFs break 2-week outflow streak with $301M comeback
US spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with $301 million in net inflows after a strong three-day start gave way to heavy withdrawals.
US-listed spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) attracted around $301 million in net inflows last week, snapping a two-week outflow streak despite heavy withdrawals late in the week.
The funds lost about $228 million the previous week and $680 million the week before. October’s net outflows stood at about $314 million, according to Farside Investors data.
Bitcoin ETFs drew $1.08 billion between Monday and Wednesday as Bitcoin (BTC) climbed to a weekly high of $84,777 on Wednesday, according to CoinGecko. Investors then withdrew about $774 million on Thursday and Friday as BTC retreated toward $80,000.
ETF investors have tended to sell into Bitcoin declines, according to research published Thursday by market maker DWF Labs. The company found net outflows during seven of eight Bitcoin sell-offs of at least 15% since US spot Bitcoin ETFs launched in January 2024.
“ETF investors aren’t the dip buyers people think they are,” DWF said.
At the time of publication, Bitcoin traded at $80,025, down around 3.3% over the past seven days. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index fell to a “Neutral” reading of 50, down from “Greed” at 59 a week earlier.
US spot Ether ETFs recorded a fourth consecutive week of net outflows, shedding about $221 million last week, according to Farside Investors data.
Related: Bitcoin seeks support above $81K as Brent crude oil hits highest level since March
items.title: Bitcoin ETFs break 2-week outflow streak with $301M comeback

巴西股票EWZ重挫23%令多头遭百万爆仓，抄底资金开始再次入场

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，据 TradingBeats 监测，截至发稿，Hyperliquid 上 Trade.xyz 部署的巴西股票 ETF 合约 EWZ 暂报 34.276 美元，24 小时下跌约 23.11%，成交额约 5529 万美元。其中，08:00 至 09:00 单小时成交约 57.63 万份，占当前 24 小时成交量约 40.6%，交易集中度明显上升。

本轮下跌伴随巴西大选结果落定，市场此前的押注方向开始反转。北京时间今日 08:08，巴西最高选举法院确认卢拉胜选连任。此前市场曾押注右翼候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗胜选，期待其推动财政收紧、降低融资成本并支撑雷亚尔走强。

路透社报道，截至上周五，巴西股市较首轮投票前上涨近 7%，雷亚尔兑美元升值近 5%。卢拉连任后，这一交易逻辑面临重新评估。

瑞银全球财富管理新兴市场首席投资官 Alejo Czerwonko 认为，首轮投票后的市场涨势可能大幅回吐，后续仍需看到可信的财政纪律承诺及债务稳定路径。

链上持仓先收缩、后有所恢复。EWZ 未平仓金额早间 1542 万美元，午间降至 895 万美元，随后回升至约 1396 万美元，较早盘低位增加约 56%，但仍低于开票阶段的水平。

成交中，已出现大额多仓强平，及盈利空仓遭自动减仓（ADL）的情况：

- 大额多头遭强平： 一笔于开票前半小时建立、成交额约 161.82 万美元的多仓，在 08:05 被全部强平，实现交易亏损约 15.23 万美元（0x615f）。

- 盈利空仓遭 ADL： 另一账户今早累计开空 6.1 万份 EWZ，其中约 2.94 万份、对应 105.60 万美元的空仓被系统自动减仓，实现交易盈利约 17.34 万美元。该账户目前仍持有约 78.7 万美元空仓，浮盈约 17.55 万美元（0x888e）。

 卢拉胜选确认后，两名账户分别于在 10 分钟内建立空仓杀跌，目前合计持仓约 208 万美元，均价分别为 34.66 美元和 34.70 美元（0x0242、0xda37）。

在价格已大幅回落后，过去半小时，另一账户于抄底开多约 99.58 万美元，均价 34.66 美元，约 2.87 万份多仓仍（0x8de4）。

资金费率也随交易方向变化而反转。07:00、08:00 两轮结算分别为每小时−0.1383% 和−0.1581%，由空头向多头付费；09:00 起连续 7 轮转正。15:00 已结算费率约为每小时+0.0128%。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373697

House of Doge重大调整：终止Dogecoin官方授权、更换CEO并拟收购McQueen Labs

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，纳斯达克上市公司 House of Doge Inc.（股票代码：HODO）于 10 月 23 日提交 8-K 文件，披露多项重大事项：

领导层变动：原 CEO Marco Margiotta 与 CFO Charles Park 于 10 月 22 日辞职。董事会任命 McQueen Labs CEO Curtis Hopkins 为临时 CEO 兼临时 CFO。

终止原 Dogecoin 官方授权：与 Dogecoin Foundation 及 MadeUpNumbers Ltd. 达成协议，终止此前的修订版商标许可协议。公司需在 2026 年 12 月 31 日前更改公司名称，并停止使用「官方企业臂」或「官方商业伙伴」等表述。同时签署新的非独家商标许可协议，仅限用于指定的 21Shares Dogecoin 相关产品及经书面批准的新产品，并需支付收入分成。

资产转让：将 Such App 移动应用相关资产转让给 ABJ Labs Inc.（运营名 Dogecoin Labs），换取价值 400 万美元的 Dogecoin Labs 普通股（基于 1.2 亿美元投前估值）。交易尚未交割。

拟收购 McQueen Labs：与 McQueen Labs 签署具有约束力的意向书，拟收购其 MCQ Markets 代币平台及小额贷款业务。代币平台对价 1500 万美元，主要以股票（普通股不超过 19.99% + 非投票可转换优先股 30%）及本票支付。

公司同时表示将评估反向拆股、融资方案及品牌重塑。

items.content:
影视飓风Tim在X上送百台iPhone，Web3撸毛工作室或为最大赢家

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，中国知名自媒体账号「影视飓风」近期出海 X 平台，作为亮相以来的首次推广活动，影视飓风推出关注、转发、点赞相关推文，赠送百台 iPhone 活动。截止发稿，相关推广视频曝光量达 487 万，点赞、转发数均超 10 万，Tim Pan 账号粉丝数也快速上涨到 30.2 万，从曝光、互动和涨粉数据看，这次海外首秀的传播效果相当直接。

不过，流量跑出来了，获奖名单却带来了另一层讨论。

据 BlockBeats 统计，该活动通过 grok 抽选出的获奖名单，100 个获奖账号中，近 7 成账号粉丝数小于 100，大量账号 handle 为随机字符组合而成（一般会被标记为批量注册特征）。此外，至少有 20 个账号发布过加密撸毛、Web3 空投、NFT 相关推文。

BlockBeats 认为，这个结果并不意外。从 NFT 热潮，到后来的项目空投，再到「嘴撸」盛行的阶段，X 账号一直是 Web3 撸毛工作室最基础的交互工具。撸毛工作室将 X 账号数量规模化之后，原本面向普通用户的抽奖，就会变成一场低成本、高赔率的概率游戏。

需要指出的是，影视飓风此前在国内平台也验证过类似活动的传播能力。其今年 9 月在 B 站举办的相关抽奖活动，曾获得超过 220 万次转发和点赞。这说明流量本身没有问题，但 X 的生态显然更复杂。

从近10亿订单到欠薪停工：南京具身智能公司无境动力CEO称联系不上实控人

动察 Beating AI 快讯，南京具身智能公司无境动力成立仅 8 个月，就被曝陷入欠薪、停工风波。

今年 6 月，南京官方媒体还在宣传这家明星企业：成立仅 4 个月，便与多家央企签订近 5 亿元框架订单，另有近 5 亿元地方市场储备订单，融资到位 1.1 亿元。公司主要研发工业级四足机器人，面向电力巡检、能源工矿等场景。7 月，江宁区政府还展示了其能识别仪表异常、操作开关的机器人，预计 10 月交付。

但仅过一个月，公司就开始欠薪。员工向《每日经济新闻》反映，8 月起工资停发，9 月停缴公积金，10 月停缴社保，涉及三四十人，欠薪总额接近 800 万元。目前公司已停工，连研发部门负责人也参与劳动仲裁。

10 月 22 日，记者联系到 CEO 袁海辉，他表示联系不上实际控制人崔小飞，不方便回应。

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，资产管理巨头富兰克林邓普顿（Franklin Templeton）向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交 Form 8-A 文件，为其两只新型交易所交易基金完成纳斯达克上市注册。招股说明书显示，产品生效日期为 10 月 27 日，市场普遍预期其将在近期启动交易。

这两只产品分别为 Franklin US Equity Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF（代码 FBEQ）和 Franklin US Innovation Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF（代码 FIBT）。前者跟踪 VettaFi US Large-Cap 500 Bitcoin DRIP Index，覆盖约 500 家市值最大的美国公司；后者跟踪 VettaFi US Innovation 100 Bitcoin DRIP Index，聚焦 100 家最大的非金融类纳斯达克上市公司。两只基金均采用被动指数策略，初始资产配置约为 95% 美国股票与 5% 比特币敞口。

据悉，产品的核心机制是「股息再投资比特币」（Bitcoin DRIP）。与传统股息再投资计划不同，这两只 ETF 不会将股票产生的普通股息与特别股息再投回股票本身，而是在除息日次日开盘时，将股息现金自动用于增加比特币相关敞口。比特币敞口主要通过比特币交易所交易产品（包括富兰克林自身的现货比特币 ETF EZBC）、期货、期权或其他相关工具实现，基金本身不直接持有链上比特币。

为控制风险，指数设定了明确的再平衡规则。若季度再平衡时比特币权重超过 5%，将减仓至 4.5%；若在再平衡间隔期间比特币权重超过 20%，则须在两个交易日内减回至 4.5%。文件显示，FBEQ 的管理费为 0.09%，FIBT 为 0.19%，两者均不收取 12b-1 费用。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Musk warns over 200 AI neoclouds face ‘guppy-level death’
The warning comes as Gartner forecasts that more than 80% of specialist cloud providers will cease operating independently by 2030.
Elon Musk warns that over 200 specialist AI cloud providers could fail or consolidate as lenders tighten up their purse strings.
Musk said Sunday on X that lenders had largely stopped providing financing to companies without substantial revenue streams outside AI data centers. He said SpaceX had secured $40 billion in debt financing for GPUs because of its investment-grade status and revenue from its Starlink satellite internet and rocket businesses.
“That means the 200+ neoclouds are going to see guppy-level death and consolidation. Some will make it through, but not many,” he said.
A neocloud is a specialist cloud company that rents out computing power for AI, usually through data centers packed with powerful GPUs.
Musk’s warning follows an October forecast from research firm Gartner that more than 80% of neocloud providers will cease operating independently by 2030, as the industry struggles to generate sufficient returns on massive AI infrastructure investments.
The warnings could also have implications for Bitcoin miners that have pivoted into AI infrastructure. For example, IREN has expanded into AI cloud services, renting computing power to customers, while Core Scientific provides data center hosting for neocloud customers such as CoreWeave.
Related: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
In its forecast, Gartner said AI providers are expected to spend nearly $1 trillion on infrastructure in 2026 and another $6 trillion between 2027 and 2030, but said there is insufficient revenue to deliver profitable returns on all those investments.
The pressure could be particularly acute for neoclouds, which must earn enough from AI computing services to sustain their operations. Larger cloud companies have more diversified revenue streams that could support AI investment for years, Gartner said.
Even strong market growth may not be enough. Gartner forecasts spending on AI-optimized infrastructure-as-a-service will rise from $66 billion in 2027 to $174 billion in 2030, but said most providers could struggle to recover their investment before the current generation of AI chips is replaced.
SpaceX sees sharp jump in AI revenue
Musk’s comments came days after SpaceX reported that its “Super Intelligence” business generated $7.6 billion in third-quarter revenue, up 830% from a year earlier and accounting for more than half of the company’s $14.6 billion in quarterly sales.
The company attributed the growth to new cloud services agreements, its acquisition of Cursor and increased adoption of its Grok AI model.
Magazine: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest

CZ建议日本政府加强数字化革新，鼓励日本年轻人投身AI、区块链创业

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，CZ 近日接受日本知名商业媒体 PIVOT 专访时强调 AI 与区块链结合的广阔商业前景，表示未来每人可能有成百上千甚至百万个后台代理（剪辑视频、发布、营销、收款等），这些代理会大量交易。AI 代理不会用信用卡/银行账户，理想是数字原生货币（加密）。AI 会把交易速度/量提升约 1000 到 100 万倍，交易可能更小（如看一个视频付 1 日元，而非固定订阅）。AI 还需要数字认证/验证，这些都应由区块链完成。

CZ 还建议未来日本政府应更数字化。「AI+区块链会让社会更高效、经济交易量更大」。其同时建议日本年轻人投身 AI、区块链创业。「今天是历史上最好的一天去创业/建设，比过去任何一天都好」。CZ 表示新环境下日本传统的「终身雇佣制」值得重新审视，相比来说「创业路径不确定性大、痛苦多，但回报、正面影响和财务收益也大。AI 让这更容易。」

items.content:
马斯克警告AI云商将迎大洗牌：GPU租金还在涨，融资却开始吃紧

动察 Beating AI 快讯，GPU 现在甚至成了一门倒卖生意。一位 AI 实验室创始人透露，他们提前锁定了大量 GPU 算力，如今 H100、B200、B300 的租金已经涨了 2～3 倍。哪怕最后训练不出顶级模型，光靠转租算力也能赚钱。

但 GPU 买到手，不代表就能用上。很多数据中心还在建设，工期却一拖再拖。投资人 Chamath 担心，2027 年会有一批 GPU 因为机房没建好、电力没接通，只能放着吃灰。即使顺利投入使用，赚到的租金也可能不够支付融资成本。

钱也越来越难借了。CoreWeave 一批债券本月一度跌到面值的 78%。相当于原本承诺到期偿还 100 美元本金的债券，现在只卖 78 美元，对应的年化到期收益率超过 16%。Gartner 甚至预测，到 2030 年，超过 80% 的新兴 AI 云商将因倒闭、被收购等原因不再独立经营。

马斯克认为，债券市场最近几周已经开始对缺乏其他收入来源的 AI 算力公司关上大门。他称 SpaceX 有星链和火箭发射业务撑腰，已完成 400 亿美元 GPU 债务融资。

至于市面上 200 多家新兴 AI 云商，马斯克判断，最终能活下来的不会太多。

⚡️马斯克警告「AI算力泡沫」：超200家新型云厂商将面临「倒闭与整合」

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，马斯克在社交媒体上针对投资者 Chamath Palihapitiya 回应表示，SpaceX 已完成约 400 亿美元债务融资，用于购买图形处理器（GPU），同时预测超过 200 家被称为「neoclouds」的新型 AI 云服务商将面临大规模失败与整合，原因是信用市场正在收紧。

据悉，Palihapitiya 表示，neoclouds 组织混乱且资本化不足，超大规模云厂商决策官僚化严重，并警告建设延迟可能在 2027 年导致大量「搁浅算力」，已采购但回报低于资本成本的硬件滞留在未完工的数据中心中。

马斯克对该言论表示认同，并补充道，债务市场「几乎完全切断了那些缺乏独立于 AI 数据中心之外可观营收的公司的融资渠道」。这意味着 200 多家 neoclouds 将面临大批死亡与整合，有些能挺过去，但不会很多。

此外马斯克还明确表示，SpaceX 不会收购任何 neoclouds，称此举「毫无意义」。

CNN：美军已准备好对伊朗发动新一轮大规模行动

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，据 CNN 报道，两名美国官员表示，中东地区的美军已做好准备，一旦收到总统唐纳德·特朗普的命令，将在 96 小时内对伊朗发动新一轮军事行动，行动规模可能相当大。

消息人士称，目前部署在该地区的美军力量已足以执行潜在的打击任务。消息人士还表示，新一轮美国军事行动的范围可能不再局限于对伊朗雷达、导弹发射装置及其他能够迅速恢复的军事资产实施打击。这类行动常被形容为「修剪草坪」，旨在定期削弱对手的军事能力。自特朗普今年早些时候叫停全面作战行动以来，美军一直采取类似做法。

一名美国官员称：「这将是一项大规模行动。」其他熟悉美国军方内部作战规划讨论的现任和前任官员也表达了类似看法。其中一些人认为，问题不在于特朗普是否会下令发动攻击，而在于何时下令。他们认为，命令可能在今年年底前的任何时候下达，但更有可能是在美国中期选举结束之后。(金十）

items.content:
Anthropic招股书最快周一公开

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 最快将于美国时间 10 月 26 日公开 IPO 招股书，计划 11 月中旬上市。

公司早在今年 6 月就已秘密向美国 SEC 提交文件。此前市场一度讨论 2 万亿美元估值，但随着 AI 相关股票承压，近期部分投资者已将预期降至约 1.5 万亿美元。

虽然招股书尚未正式公开，但路透社和《华尔街日报》已经拿到草稿。今年上半年，Anthropic 营收达到 163 亿美元，去年同期只有 11 亿美元。同期净亏损高达 807 亿美元，不过其中约 720 亿美元来自可转债等融资工具的估值调整，并非实际烧掉的现金。

增长也开始放缓。Anthropic 第三季度收入达到 168 亿美元，环比增长约 45%，上一季度的增幅则超过 140%。公司称第三季度已按调整后口径实现盈利。但其未来云计算、芯片和数据中心等基础设施承诺已经超过 6000 亿美元，这些支出将在未来多年陆续发生。

另一个问题是对科技巨头的依赖。2025 年，Anthropic 有 47% 的收入通过亚马逊和 Google 的云平台销售。这两家公司同时还是它的投资方和算力供应商。

控制权同样特殊。Anthropic 计划让七位联合创始人通过特殊股权结构，共同掌握 50.1% 的投票权。而由非股东组成的长期公益信托，仍可任免董事会多数成员。

即将公开的正式招股书，还需要进一步说明两家大客户的真实收入贡献、算力合同的具体成本，以及老股东能否在上市时率先出售股票。

加密网红kimchi bio再加「pump.fun」，同名meme币短时冲高一倍后回落

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，加密网红 kimchi X 账号简介今晨再度更改为「@pumpfun」，受此影响，据 GMGN 行情，此前速通盘代币「Kimchi」于 600 万美元市值处快速涨超 1 倍，触及 1200 万美元后回落，现报 923 万美元，24 小时成交额达 410 万美元。

加密网红 kimchi 与 pump.fun 之间的合作堪称狗血闹剧。10 月 20 日，速通盘代币「Kimchi」在一系列利好下速通 4700 万美元，随后一路下跌。此间市场传闻 pump.fun 为邀请 kimchi 代言，支付了 13.5 亿枚 PUMP 代币，价值约合 625 万美元。

然而，23 日，kimchi 发布二维码，指向另一 Kimchi 代币，该代币短时暴涨至 1000 万美元市值后迅速归零。期间多个钱包提前低价买入 KIMCHI，并在价格上涨后卖出，累计获利超过 38.5 万美元。随后 kimchi 本人 bio 删掉「@pumpfun」字样，直至今晨再度添加。

BlockBeats 提醒用户，名人 meme 币受当事人行为严重影响，价格波动大，容易滋生内幕盘、老鼠仓，用户投资需谨慎。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
BOSS直聘开源33B Agent模型：20项自评领先17项，最终目标却是3B

动察 Beating AI 快讯，BOSS 直聘旗下南北阁实验室发布开源模型 Nanbeige4.3-33B，主打编程和办公 Agent，支持 512K 上下文，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

官方将其与 Qwen3.8-27B、Meta Muse Glimmer 30B 和 Gemma 4 31B 进行比较。在公布的 20 项测试中，Nanbeige 有 17 项排名第一。Terminal-Bench 2.1 得分 80.9，高于 Qwen 的 73.0；DeepSWE 达到 65.5，对手只有 42.5。办公自动化测试 Automation Bench 也以 54.2 领先 Qwen 的 38.3。不过，SWE-Bench Pro 和 GDPval 仍由 Qwen 领先。

有意思的是，南北阁此前主要研发 3B 级小模型，上一代 Nanbeige4.2-3B 还通过重复使用 Transformer 层，在不增加参数的情况下提高模型的有效计算深度。这次团队反而先训练出一个 33B 大模型，准备让它充当「老师」，再把编程、工具调用等能力蒸馏给即将推出的 Nanbeige4.3-3B。

Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
The Nasdaq-listed firm said it plans to establish Solana validator operations in Hong Kong.
Hong Kong has named Nasdaq-listed Solana Company (HSDT) a strategic enterprise under a government program aimed at attracting businesses that support the city’s economic development.
Solana Company said Thursday that it was among the seventh batch of businesses selected by Hong Kong’s Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises (OASES) and the only blockchain infrastructure company onboarded by the office in 2026.
Hong Kong’s government confirmed the addition of 18 enterprises to the program last week, bringing its total to 142.
A Solana Company spokesperson told Cointelegraph that the designation gives it a single point of contact across government agencies and regulators, expedited pathways for recruiting overseas talent and introductions to local institutional partners.
Solana Company operates staking and validator infrastructure and advises financial institutions on blockchain adoption. It also holds Solana (SOL) as part of its digital asset treasury strategy.
The company said it plans to establish validator operations in Hong Kong under Pacific Backbone, an initiative to build a low-latency blockchain infrastructure network across the Asia-Pacific region.
Related: Solana Company to back Kazakhstan’s $6B crypto megacity ambition

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Tailscale被曝11项安全问题：给服务器装了防盗门，却可能让黑客拿走总钥匙

动察 Beating AI 快讯，最近不少开发者建议，保护 VPS 最好的办法之一，就是关闭公网 SSH 入口，改用 Tailscale 远程访问。

结果 10 月 25 日，安全研究员 Erica Windisch 公布了一份名为 Tailworm 的报告，在 Tailscale 及其开源替代方案 headscale 中存在 11 项安全问题。最严重的一种情况，恰恰出在 Tailscale 自带的 SSH 功能上。

攻击者不需要破解 VPN。只要控制一台已获准通过 Tailscale SSH 访问目标服务器的设备，且 SSH 转发权限开放，就可能进一步夺取服务器的 root 权限。

漏洞出在权限隔离：Tailscale 后台以 root 身份运行，部分 SSH 转发操作也沿用了这个权限。研究员在实验中利用 Unix Socket 转发，绕过普通账户限制，成功通过 Docker 获得服务器 root 权限。

另一条攻击链还截获了设备注册密钥，在未启用 Tailnet Lock 的测试网络中加入了一台伪造服务器。

Tailscale 今年 6 月才修复过 SSH 的 Unix Socket 转发越权漏洞。同月，它还堵住了通过数字用户 ID `0` 取得 root 的漏洞；7 月又修复了通过特殊用户名 `-i` 绕过权限限制的问题。几个月后，研究员从同一套内置 SSH 的转发机制中，再次找到了提权路径。

Tailscale 工程副总裁 Mike Shaver 随后承认，团队已发现 SSH 授权后的权限越界问题，但尚未确认研究报告的全部结论，也不建议所有用户直接停用 Tailscale SSH。

10 月 25 日，工程团队在 GitHub 连续提交多项 SSH 改造方案，准备让转发操作使用实际登录用户的权限，而不是直接交给 root 进程执行。目前相关修复尚未发布正式版本。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373644

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
当前主流CEX、DEX资金费率显示市场仍维持中性

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，据 Coinglass 数据，比特币今日再次跌破 8 万美元关口，但当前主流 CEX、DEX 资金费率显示市场看跌态势减弱，整体仍维持在中性区间，具体资金费率如附图所示。

BlockBeats 注：资金费率是加密货币交易平台为了保持合约价格与标的资产价格之间的平衡而设定的费率，通常适用于永续合约。它是多空交易者之间的资金交换机制，交易平台并不收取此费用，用于调整交易者持有合约的成本或收益，以使合约价格与标的资产价格保持接近。

当资金费率为 0.01% 时，表示基准费率。当资金费率大于 0.01% 时，代表市场普遍看多。当资金费率小于 0.005% 时，代表市场普遍看跌。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
A security researcher warned that the leaked shipping details could expose crypto holders to targeted scams and physical attacks.
Crypto hardware wallet maker Keystone has disclosed a website security breach that exposed customer information to attackers, raising concerns about targeted scams and physical attacks.
Keystone said Saturday that it detected suspicious activity earlier in the week and confirmed Friday, after reviewing API activity with Shopify, that an unauthorized third party had accessed customer shipping information. This included names, contact details, shipping addresses and other order details, such as items bought.
“We’ve blocked access, fixed the vulnerability, opened an investigation, and are emailing affected customers,” said the company.
Keystone warned that the exposed information could be used for targeted phishing attacks. However, security researcher Taylor Monahan also raised concerns that leaking shipping addresses could expose customers to physical attacks and kidnappings.
Blockchain security firm CertiK recorded 52 verified wrench attacks worldwide in the first half of 2026, up 33% from 39 during the same period last year. Such crimes, commonly called “wrench attacks,” involve using physical threats or violence to force cryptocurrency holders to surrender their assets.
“Again, we’re truly sorry to everyone affected,” Keystone said. The company did not disclose how many customers were impacted.
Keystone questioned over promise to delete customer data
The breach has also raised questions about Keystone’s handling of older customer information.
In a 2023 blog post, Keystone said it had reduced its customer data retention period to 180 days following security incidents affecting other hardware wallet manufacturers.
However, some customers said they received breach notifications despite purchasing their devices more than two years ago, raising questions about what information Keystone retained and whether the notifications indicate that older order records were not deleted as promised.
Related: Italy investigates government email breach linked to Revolut data leak
An X user going by “OG DEGEN” said they received a call from a scammer claiming they were law enforcement investigating a fraud case. The user suspected the caller obtained their information through a Keystone order placed in 2024, based on the personal information the caller referred to.
“I think their plan was to convince me that my private keys had been exposed and then send me a phishing link to supposedly reset them,” they wrote on X.
Another X user, trintaetres, also said they received the email notification despite buying the device over two years ago.
Cointelegraph contacted Keystone to ask how customer information from purchases made more than 180 days earlier could have been exposed despite its previously announced retention policy, and how many customers were affected. The company did not respond by publication time.

--- Top Comments ---

[jacquesm]: It's absolutely true. I have three different setups here, a rig with 8 gpus that I use in either one of two modes (all 8, very heavy model or just one much lighter) and two DGX sparks. I haven't used a paid model in months. Sure, they use a few more tokens and the results may be slightly less good (but this doesn't really matter because I'm still in the loop so it is easy to correct). But the fact that I'm not sharing my work with the paid providers is much more to my...

[robrenaud]: Are there inference products focused on say, optimizing frequently used internal contexts, so that they are compact in the kv cache?  Perhaps there rep could be optimized over hundreds+ of distinct real use cases? Maybe your law firm doesn't want your data going outside your business.  But you obviously want high quality analysis.

[Frannky]: You can try open models via OpenRouter and omp without having to buy or rent any GPU. I routinely try open models to see where they are. GLM 5.3 with DSFV4.1 as advisor via omp feels Opus 4.6 level, i.e. totally able to ship stuff. I do use Anthropic and OpenAI mostly because it costs me 1/40 and 1/50 of the api prices, which is way cheaper than Chinese subscriptions, but I’m ready to jump ship when they pull the plug. Fortunately they have nothing that forces me to keep paying them...

[jillesvangurp]: It's going to boil down to cost of the hardware vs. pay per use cloud models. I'm on the 100$/month chatgpt plan (~88euro). With all the resets, credits, and all the rest I typically don't run out of tokens. This is fine for me. I might go to the 200$/month plan at some point. In comparison, my highend mac book pro costs 105 euro per month (leasing cost). That's not quite enough to run the bigger models and besides running the GPU on a laptop constantly makes it ...

[mattlondon]: I think, despite the desperate attempt at IBM to remain relevant (and in business), their CEO has a point here that do you really need SOTA models for everything? I had a really nice time with GLM5.2 for a month or two - it was, in my experience, approx Opus 4.5ish level of capability when I think Opus 4.8 was the new hotness Even today, I use Gemini 3.8 Flash as my daily driver for most coding. Its fast and good, even if it is not the absolute SOTA at coding benchmarks it really is very good...

韩国「存储双雄」三季度营业利润预计超184万亿韩元，2025年同期为90.8万亿韩元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，本周韩国「存储双雄」将公布 2026 年第三季度业绩：SK 海力士定于周三发布财报，三星电子将紧随其后于周四发布财报。随着 AI 芯片需求上涨以及存储芯片价格走高，这两家存储芯片巨头有望交出史上最强业绩之一，三季度合计营业利润预计将达到 184.4 万亿韩元（约合 1391 亿美元）。

三星电子 10 月 8 日公布的初步业绩显示，公司第三季度营业利润为 107.4 万亿韩元（约合 801.7 亿美元），较上年同期的 12.17 万亿韩元飙升近 8 倍。而据市场追踪机构 FnGuide 调查的分析师预计，SK 海力士第三季度营收将达 98.2 万亿韩元，营业利润将达 77 万亿韩元。相比之下，三星（43.6 万亿韩元）和 SK 海力士（47.2 万亿韩元）2025 年的营业利润合计为 90.8 万亿韩元。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373633

items.content:
Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
The Standard Chartered and Animoca Brands joint venture previously targeted retail access as early as the end of 2026, but its CEO declined to reaffirm that timeline.
Standard Chartered-backed stablecoin venture Anchorpoint says it will take a cautious approach to opening its Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin to retail users, declining to confirm a launch date after rival HSBC rolled out RedCoin, according to the South China Morning Post.
The venture released its institutional stablecoin product in August and previously indicated a retail offering could arrive as early as the end of 2026.
Anchorpoint CEO Dominic Maffei declined to confirm that timeline at a Friday press conference, saying the company would take a prudent approach.
“We believe it’s important to build the market out in a long-term, sustainable manner,” Maffei said, adding that rushing a launch “does not make sense.”
The update comes after HSBC launched its Hong Kong dollar-backed RedCoin on Friday for the 3.3 million users of its PayMe app.
Anchorpoint grew out of a partnership between Standard Chartered, Animoca Brands and telecommunications provider HKT, which was announced in February 2025, following their joint participation in Hong Kong’s stablecoin issuer sandbox in July 2024.
Animoca’s role is to bring its blockchain expertise and industry network to the venture and help develop uses for the stablecoin across the Web3 ecosystem.
Related: HashKey begins beta distribution of Hong Kong-regulated HKDAP stablecoin
items.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
